contexts.text: They go round to their backs and shake their fists at them, but when they see them face to face, they salute them, and again go round to their backs and hit them with their fists...
A cold feeling (from the Antediluvians) which invaded the lower region of the back.
The position... of malignant Spirits is behind the back. AC 4327:2.
What is separated from anyone is represented by a certain throwing away as it were behind the back...
They who act at the hinder part, desire to exercise command.
The Spirits... who are under the back of the head are those who act silently and prudently; those who are close behind the back, act in the same way, but with a difference.
Those who constitute the province of the gall bladder are behind the back... SE 1012.
Such (Spirits), after undergoing punishment, are cast behind the back, deep down.
Genii are in Hells behind the back, deep down... AC 8593. AC 9671:3. HH 123. HH 311:2. HH 544.
It was observed that this sphere inflows into the outward sensual sphere, and in fact, into the hinder part, where are situated the involuntary things of man.
In the perception of Spirits... the planet Mercury appears behind the back, a little towards the right.
Then are the things which are of the Lord behind their backs...
In the Spiritual World, voluntary things are presented behind the back, or behind, and intellectual things before the face, or before.
(The Spirits of Jupiter) take extreme care that, not only when they are walking, but also when they are sitting down, they are not looked at behind their backs.
The Lord then appears behind his back.
One (of the Spirits of the Moon) carried another on his back...

The sun of the world does not appear, when the Angels think of it, but in its stead there appears something which is darksome... behind their backs; there also is the west to the Heavens. AC 10584:end.
When a man turns himself away from the Lord, which takes place when he does what is evil, then, because the Lord is behind his back, it appears to him as if the Lord does not see him...

The more those who are in Hell are in the love of self and in the love of the world, the more they turn themselves from the Lord, and have Him behind their backs; and this however, and to whatever quarter, they turn themselves.
Behind the back are those who are in a dim perception of what is good, thus in the west.
They who are in Hell have the Lord constantly behind their backs... AC 10307:2.
The man who is in (the loves of self and of the world), as to his interiors, actually turns himself away from the Lord, for he turns his back to Him...
All infernal Spirits turn their backs to the Lord as a Sun... In like manner man as to his spirit...
No one is ever permitted, in Heaven, to stand behind the back of another, and to look at the back of his head...
The Angels... have the west behind their backs. General article.
Behind their backs is the east...
It is given to man to see the Divine Providence on the back... General article.

I saw a Book... written within and on the back... By within is meant in everything particular; and by on the back, in everything general. By within and on the back is also meant the interior sense of the Word, which is spiritual, and its exterior sense, which is natural.

This sphere surrounds a man on the back and on the breast; thinly however, on the back... Hence it is that two married partners who... disagree in their affections, lie in bed turned away from each other, back to back...

I will call some evil Spirit, who has turned himself from God, and I will speak to him behind his back, or into the back of his head; and you will see that what is said will be turned into the opposite. Example(s).
This is why... in the Spiritual World, no one is allowed to stand behind the back of another, and speak to him...
Wherefore, when Hell is looked into from Heaven, their... backs only are seen.
There are other states which cause affliction to Souls... namely, their supposing that they are carrying men on their backs, who interrogate them...

They who are about a man behind his back are they who want to exercise command over his body, and suppose themselves to be the man, wherefore they thus adhere to the man when they come to him. They who want to be bodies, and those also who torment man after death, adhere to the back, nor do they depart until he has disclosed what is sought for. SE 637.
Spirits... when with men, standing at their backs, suppose that they are entirely the men...
SE 870. These regiments of Spirits (of the urinary sphincter) apply themselves to the hinder part low down, near the, and inflict the penalty of tearing.
(The Spirit of Jupiter) now showed me a new action, of which he before was ignorant; namely, one that was softly pulsative; it was about the part of the back which is above the hip...

(There are wandering Spirits who long to know, not ordinary, but very secret matters of faith, in order to lead others astray) and whom they cause to pass between their feet from behind, they then take hold of them and turn them round, and throw them as it were on their backs, as their booty, or spoil, and then go away.
Under Occiput, see this reference. SE 1748.
The speech which falls down from Heaven into interior good Spirits, was represented by a woman walking with a man... whose back only was seen.

Wherefore he withdrew behind the back more and more, with the intention of seeking another Lord and another Heaven... The distance was further behind the back than I supposed was possible within the space of the Grand Body.
Such there, are at a distance behind the back... who live merely to enjoy a soft and sweet life...

It was then seen that she applied herself to his back, and so took possession of him (Aristotle); which was a representation of how such Spirits ruled him; for to be applied to the back is to command.
That witch eluded punishments in various ways... From others behind the back who seemed to conceal themselves behind the Sun where the Lord is...
They who lie in ambush behind the back are the worst, and are they who, in the world, did everything in a secret way.
On those who are behind the back.
Obstinate Spirits who held another by the elbows behind the back...

He had others behind the back who directed others who were there; for the case in the other life is that those who are behind the back and lie in ambush, are those who, in the world, lay in ambush secretly.
He was punished by such another who also applied himself to him behind his back...

The Hell of such is under the sole of the left foot, a little on the left hand there, whither he was cast; and when he got there and carried on the same tricks, he also threw himself upon them from behind...
On those who lie in ambush behind a man's back.

They who enter into a man's affections and thoughts lie in ambush behind the back, both below and above, close by and far off; they who are at the back of the loins enter into the affections of his thought, and when they once come to a man, they leave him not until his death; they are those who are in his dominant affection...

A Book written within and on the back = the state of life of all in Heaven and on earth, in general and in particular... Within and on the back = that which is in the heart and soul, or in the love and faith; for love is within a man and a Spirit, because it constitutes his life; but faith, unless it is in his love, is not within him, but behind, or at the back...
When Hell... heaves up its back to the borders of the Heavens...
